heroDesc: 15 minutes to review your LinkedIn positioning, audience strategy, and growth bottlenecks with no pressure or sales pitch.

expectations.title: You talk, I listen
expectations.body: Tell me about your current offer, who you help, and where your inbound growth is currently stuck.

expectations.title: We analyze your profile & strategy
expectations.body: We review your headline, about section, and content cadence to pinpoint immediate conversion leaks.

expectations.title: You leave with clarity
expectations.body: Whether we partner together or not, you will leave with an actionable roadmap to fix your LinkedIn pipeline.
